title: eludite.test.explorer input
description: Test > Test Explorer (Ctrl+E, T): show the Test Explorer window. When nothing is discovered for the open workspace yet, it discovers the tests of the build outputs as they are (eludite.test.discover with `rebuild: false`); a project that is not built says so. With `filter`, its search box shows that text (Visual Studio's `FullName:`, `Outcome:` and `Trait:` filters, or a substring of the name), as typing in it does. The output is the window's place (view-tool-window.output.json).

filter.description: The search box's text: `FullName:<text>`, `Outcome:<Passed|Failed|Skipped|Not Run>`, `Trait:<Name=Value>` and plain text (a case-insensitive substring of the test's name or full name), every term holding. Empty clears it.
